_metadata.description: Validated component-to-design-style fit signals used by search, adoption workflows, and the console.

requirements.title: Design-style ids come from the canonical template registry
requirements.description: The component service loads design styles from `templates/design/*/metadata.json` and exposes them through `components styles` / `ComponentsService.ListDesignStyles`. Component manifests are reconciled against those style ids during indexing so stale references are visible to operators.

validation.notes: api/internal/components/styles_test.go verifies canonical style loading and direct unknown-id validation.

requirements.title: Component manifests declare advisory design-style affinities
requirements.description: `component.json` supports component-scoped `designStyles[]` entries with `styleId`, `affinity` (`native`, `compatible`, or `discouraged`), and optional `reason`. Indexing rejects invalid affinities and duplicate style ids; unknown style ids are reported as stale findings without rejecting the component.

validation.notes: api/internal/components/indexer_test.go verifies successful parsing, optional rationale parsing, invalid-affinity rejection, and unknown-style staleness findings.

requirements.title: Affinities are indexed, searchable, and visible to operators
requirements.description: A fresh index populates `component_design_affinities`; component list/get responses include affinity rows; CLI and UI support style/affinity filtering and render discouraged-style badges.

validation.notes: api/internal/components/sqlite_test.go verifies persistence, optional rationale round-trip, and style/affinity filtering; cli/domains/components and ComponentsCard tests verify operator surfaces.
Live dev DB re-index on 2026-07-08 indexed 10 components and populated 30 affinity rows.

requirements.title: Scenario design fit can be validated from service.json
requirements.description: `ValidateStyleFit` reads a target scenario's `.vrooli/service.json` `generation.design.id`, compares it to component affinity declarations, and returns a rationale-bearing ok/info/warn verdict.

validation.notes: api/internal/components/service_test.go covers native, compatible, discouraged, undeclared-style, missing-style, missing-reader, and traversal-guard behavior. The components proto now exposes ValidateStyleFit end-to-end through Connect-RPC, the CLI adds `components style-fit`, and the adoption dialog validates style fit alongside dependency fit with warn acknowledgement gating.

requirements.title: Stale design-style references are non-fatal health findings
requirements.description: A re-index over a component affinity whose `styleId` no longer exists in the canonical design catalogue emits a non-fatal `stale_design_style` finding and keeps indexing otherwise valid component data.

validation.notes: api/internal/components/indexer_test.go verifies the non-fatal stale finding; api/handlers/components/module_test.go verifies the existing index response exposes it as a visible `finding:stale_design_style` message. A dedicated structured health table/RPC/UI surface is still pending.
